'''Drew Scott''' (DeckTech handle '''drew man1''')<ref name="dt-23182">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23182 BHBM how to kill combat], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 6 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23182/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23182/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009183912/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23182/ Wayback Machine].</ref> won the [[2005 World Championship]] at Gen Con in Indianapolis, defeating [[James Booker]].<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref> He posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech (''BHBM how to kill combat'').
